scope: Read-only preservation audit against the pre-background-upgrade snapshot. Collision/layout and authoritative combat preservation; source inspection of Shrine localized-flow clock/parallax contract. Does not substitute for rendered motion, pause/reset, or performance tests.

shrine_flow_metadata.localization: Ribbons follow illustrated waterfall locations and are gated by white/blue source pixels. Flow masks and texture lookup share UV + parallax_offset. Foliage motion is green-color-gated at the margins, lagoon motion begins beneath UV.y 0.73, and there is no whole-image time-dependent displacement.
shrine_flow_metadata.clock: scene_time from tick / 60.0; reset sets 0; pause stops stage.step; camera parallax remains camera-owned.
shrine_flow_metadata.low: Flow, lagoon ripple, mist, reduced foliage sway and three flock members retained.
